findings.reason: Glossary observation, not a defect here: this locale renders the settle term two ways - label «Đã xử lý» (shipped ui.chat.asks.settled_heading, and this panel's filter.settled chip) and clause «đã được giải quyết» (shipped ui.chat.asks.clause.settled «Mọi câu hỏi đã được giải quyết», ui.chat.ask_queue.refusal.already_settled). The changed namespace uses «xử lý» in both its clauses, which agrees with the filter chip that sits on the same screen and with the shipped heading, so the in-scope bytes are right; the divergence lives in the two shipped (carried, out-of-scope) namespaces and is recorded for a later wave rather than churned here.

findings.reason: After the em dash a bare verb phrase («gửi tin nhắn của bạn như đã viết») reads as an instruction to send, while the English present participle is a statement of what happens («sending your message as written»); a passive clause «vẫn được gửi» carries the English sense without the imperative reading. Placeholders and the em-dash punctuation are unchanged.

findings.proposed: {length, plural, other {# ký tự}} giờ là VĂN BẢN THUẦN trong ô soạn tin — nhấn Enter sẽ làm lộ nội dung đó
findings.reason: «chúng» is a plural-only pronoun and the count can be 1: unredactedNotice(length) is called with the character count of the unredacted buffer (src/renderer/src/features/chat/components/credential-capture.ts:2432), so length=1 renders «1 ký tự giờ là VĂN BẢN THUẦN trong ô soạn tin — nhấn Enter sẽ làm lộ chúng» - a number/pronoun mismatch. vi CLDR is other-only, so the count cannot be branched; a neutral «nội dung đó» is correct at every count. Pre-existing (the s3c remediation touched only armed/empty_span/empty_span_draft), recorded because a full audit re-reads every key.

findings.current: Chỉ là lịch sử; không phải quyền để dùng lại quyền truy cập.

findings.reason: «quyền … quyền truy cập» repeats the same noun inside one clause («permission to reuse access» rendered word for word); a verb phrase («không cho phép dùng lại …») is what a Vietnamese reader expects and keeps the English meaning exactly.
